# Eldur Studio

Eldur Studio builds proactive AI agents for specific marketing jobs.
Its primary offers are ready-to-use agents and productized services,
including Watchtower and the free B2B Messaging Workshop plugin for Codex.
Custom agent builds are also available for work that needs a tailored scope.

## Ready-to-use offers

### Watchtower

Watchtower is an agent-assisted maintenance and change-request service for
existing Webflow websites. It checks a site each week and prepares supported
maintenance fixes on a preview site. Customers review changes and approve
them before anything goes live.

The plan costs $299 per month and includes two custom change requests each
month by email. It suits non-technical owners who want their Webflow site
maintained without operating Webflow Designer themselves. Subscription
onboarding requires site access; the free audit inspects public pages
without Webflow account access. Watchtower currently supports Webflow.

Product details and free audit: https://webflow.eldur.studio/

### B2B Messaging Workshop

The B2B Messaging Workshop is a free Codex plugin. It uses professional
product marketing frameworks to guide users through who their product is
for, the problems it solves, and why customers choose it. The plugin asks
one question at a time and saves the answers as a reusable messaging document.

It suits people working on product messaging who want a guided workshop
they can use in Codex. It is a separate offer from Watchtower, not a website
maintenance subscription.

Install in Codex: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6a8f237c51488191a3bb6c3accefc4b5

## Custom agents

Eldur Studio also builds custom agents for marketing and sales operations.
Examples include lead qualification, CRM updates, ad monitoring, SEO content,
and reporting. Custom projects are scoped to the client's business, with a
fixed fee agreed before the build starts. The work includes connecting the
agents to the client's tools and training the team to run them.

Custom-build scope, ownership, and handoff apply to that project. They do not
replace the setup requirements or ongoing subscription terms of a separate
product such as Watchtower.
